overrun_explanation: The first formal invocation completed epoch 1 but failed in a newly added read-only diagnostic because the runtime Torch lacks torch.flatnonzero. The invalid attempt was preserved, never resumed, and followed by the one allowed functional retest and a fresh formal run. Its 1,810 physics steps make total execution exceed the declared all-in ceiling by 420 steps; this cost is not hidden or attributed to the valid algorithm result.
